subject: general
question: Where was the first indigenously owned bicycle-manufacturing unit of India, Atlas Cycles, established in the 1950s?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonipat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atlas Cycles (Haryana) Ltd. formerly known as Atlas Cycle Industries (ACIL)** begin with the production of bicycle saddles in 1951 and produced its first bicycle in 1952. 
 
• From a modest starting of **120 cycles per day,** the company has come a long way to set off **India's second-biggest cycle manufacturer.**
 
• Born in a **Tin Shed, Swadeshi 'Atlas' **set off as **India's** Largest Cycle Maker by 1965.
 
• Atlas Cycles Ltd was accepted by Janki Das Kapur in a small shed in Haryana to make budget cycles.
